updates.title: Merged Sparkle and bundled-runtime acceptance complete
updates.message: PR #1250 merged as e75ff72e5 after all CI and review gates passed. Apple accepted and stapled build 9; Sparkle installed it from the signed private feed, independent status proved build 8 stale before repair and build 9 fresh afterward, and install-required-runtime-services passed without an administrator prompt. Helper 1.3.0 and VirtualHID remained healthy.

updates.title: R02 unattended approval and repair proven
updates.message: A fresh randomized macOS 15 Tart clone completed genuine Input Monitoring approval, runtime convergence, Kanata damage/repair, evidence capture, and cleanup without operator input.

updates.title: Post-boot USB attach route closed by source and live evidence
updates.message: The signed Tart fork does implement device hot-attach, but only through an XHCI controller present when the VM is created. Matched live trials already proved that macOS 15 stalls before networking whenever that controller is present, while Apple does not support adding a controller to a running VM. Repeating the boot variants would not create new evidence; one onsite mWave event remains.

updates.title: Final P02-P04 onsite event packaged
updates.message: Commits 2e7caa66f and d3e640ea9 add a two-stage physical remap session. The mini currently reports Product mWave from Kinesis Corporation, and that exact match is wired into the onsite command. The watcher sanitizes retained inventory and records P02 output, P03 physical-Q overlay state, and P04 launch-to-output timing from one held key.

updates.title: M13 weekly pairwise plan proven
updates.message: The operator-supervised weekly expansion deterministically selects ten jobs in six provider-safe waves and covers all 81 eligible factor pairs. Shared macOS 26 identity work is serialized; physical P02 remains opt-in and excluded from automated pass criteria.

updates.title: M12 unattended nightly diagonal proven
updates.message: The nightly plan selects local contract checks plus the packaged macOS 27 selector scenario in one safe wave. Lease cbx_b31f2d95334f passed with pinned Python 3.12.13, retained semantic selector evidence, and was destroyed by the owned cleanup path.

updates.title: M07 real cancellation and recovery proven
updates.message: Lease cbx_9e1c128d616f captured the genuine KeyPath uninstall confirmation and cancelled it through lease-owned RFB. App identity, GUI, configuration, and runtime remained intact; Kanata was then deliberately booted out, independently observed degraded, repaired once, and returned to ready runtime with valid TCP output.

updates.title: M04, M05, and M06 lifecycle proofs passed
updates.message: The managed Tart lease proved a real reboot with stable signed identity and post-boot readiness, corrected CLI uninstall with no orphaned process, and exact-candidate same-lease reinstall with preserved configuration and one checkpointed convergence.

updates.title: Corrected clone ready; notarization exceeded cutoff
updates.message: Replacement lease cbx_9e1c128d616f completed randomized enrollment and acknowledged all exact-build profiles for commit bd3e81e08. Apple submission 74c86813 remains In Progress after 15 minutes, so installation is held at the release-realistic gate. No lab setup or permission step is blocking the resume.

updates.title: M05 caught an orphaned-app uninstall defect
updates.message: Lease cbx_cc3e5c6f5813 reached fully ready runtime and TCP health. The supported uninstall removed the bundle, helper, and services but left the running KeyPath GUI process alive; the independent assertion rejected the run. Commit bd3e81e08 fixes CLI uninstall by closing the app first. A signed exact candidate is now in Apple notarization before rerun.

updates.title: M05 live proof and M06 contract work started
updates.message: The uninstall track is defining independent owned-component and configuration-preservation postconditions before mutating a fresh managed clone. M06 is being authored in parallel, while its live reinstall remains correctly serialized behind M05.

updates.title: M02 one-pass Kanata repair proven
updates.message: Fresh randomized macOS 15 lease cbx_a9262dab5a98 passed exact-build managed admission and began independently ready. The scenario booted Kanata out, proved the degraded state, ran commit ce7441fd's repair once, and independently verified a fresh running service plus a valid TCP response.

updates.title: M04 false-green paths closed
updates.message: Commit 26d1c11c4 makes the reboot proof require pre-reboot readiness, a changed boot marker, unchanged signed app identity, and post-reboot runtime/TCP readiness. The lab, scenario runner, result contract, and runtime assertion suites pass; final live proof still needs trusted Input Monitoring consent.

updates.title: M04 stopped at trusted Input Monitoring boundary
updates.message: The exact managed clone proved helper, driver, virtual HID, and KeyPath permission health. Visual Kanata switch changes did not commit real consent: both Kanata permission checks remain false, the process is stopped, and TCP refuses connection. Synthetic UI and reboot retries are now stopped; the next step is a trusted Parallels input adapter or a human console action.

updates.title: Reusable macOS 27 desktop base proven
updates.message: A brand-new CrabBox lease from KeyPath macOS 27 Desktop Base reached the inherited keypathqa console, passed desktop bootstrap, accepted authenticated RFB input, and passed the live macOS 27 selector capture. updates.title: Remote Management on; credential loop stopped
updates.message: RFB reaches the macOS 27 guest but rejects the UI password. Three identical helper attempts changed no postcondition, so that path was stopped. A tested replacement now sends one explicit paced press/release batch and reports delivery without claiming authentication.

updates.title: Host re-lock cause identified
updates.message: The mini did not sleep: caffeinate assertions remained active. ScreensharingAgent deliberately restored the lock screen after its connection timed out. The durable fix is known but requires one host administrator authentication after unlock.

updates.title: M11 native permission owner proven; host console relocked
updates.message: Fresh-clone setup passed and the signed native Peekaboo Lab Host now owns the stable manual bridge. Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Remote Management remain because the mini's clawd desktop unexpectedly returned to its login screen.

updates.title: M11 permission ownership isolated
updates.message: The clean macOS 27 candidate proved standalone SSH launches cannot become a reusable Screen Recording identity. A stable Peekaboo Lab Host app now owns the TCC boundary; fresh immutable-source validation is next.

updates.title: M11 candidate provisioned; privacy approvals next
updates.message: Pinned tool provisioning now works from the clean macOS 27 source. The active candidate is ready for one-time Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Remote Management approval.

updates.message: PR #1206 contains the fail-closed macOS 27 selector driver. Clone evidence is preserved, disposable capacity is clear, and M11 is now building the reusable Desktop Automation Base.
